pages.title: About us | ConocoPhillips
pages.main_text_excerpt:
About us
ConocoPhillips is one of the world’s largest independent E&P companies based on production and proved reserves.
Across our 15 countries of operations, our people work in a truly integrated way to find and produce oil and natural gas.
Our technical capabilities, asset quality and scale, and financial strength are unmatched among independent exploration and production companies and uniquely position us to compete around the world.
ConocoPhillips is committed to the efficient and effective exploration and production of oil and natural gas. Producing oil and natural gas and getting them to market takes ingenuity, technology and investment. Our innovative, collaborative efforts yield products that improve quality of life globally while producing economic benefits with far-reaching influence.
Our people
Our strategy, performance, culture and reputation are fueled by our world-class workforce — the heart of our company and business success. We recognize that attracting and developing talent is a competitive imperative within our changing industry
Safety, health & security
The guiding principle that “work is never so urgent or important that we cannot take the time to do it safely and in an environmentally responsible manner” is core to our day-to-day operations.

pages.title: ConocoPhillips Center | ConocoPhillips
pages.main_text_excerpt:
ConocoPhillips Center
Completed in 2018, our headquarters in Houston, Texas includes two state-of-the-art buildings named after our foundational SPIRIT Values.
SPIRIT ONE and SPIRIT TWO are connected by a SkyBridge and were designed to provide efficient, functional and collaborative spaces for employees. Together, they form the ConocoPhillips Center, which includes first-class office spaces, a multi-level Wellness Center, a cafeteria, two coffee shops, multiple training and conference areas, and onsite medical, dental and dry cleaning facilities. The center also provides a glimpse into the vibrancy and innovation of ConocoPhillips and the foundation on which our company is built. It’s not just where we work – it’s where our employees exemplify our SPIRIT Values each day. Click here to learn more about our SPIRIT Values.

pages.title: Executive Leadership team | ConocoPhillips
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Leads the company in driving a unique combination of organic growth, financial returns and an attractive yield.
Leads the teams responsible for commercial and strategy.
Leads the teams responsible for finance, digital technology and transformation.
Leads the teams responsible for human resources and real estate and facilities services.
Leads the team responsible for the company’s global operations and technical functions.
Serves as counsel providing oversight on all legal issues impacting the corporation and oversees global security, communications, brand, charitable investments and corporate events.
Leads a team who serve as the voice of ConocoPhillips in addressing highly complex public policy issues with governments around the world.

pages.title: Our history | ConocoPhillips
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Our history
Photo caption: ConocoPhillips announces on May 1, 2012, that it has completed the spinoff of its downstream businesses to its stockholders. With the completion of this transaction, ConocoPhillips is the world’s largest independent exploration and production (E&P) company, based on proved reserves and production of liquids and natural gas.
A long and proud past of finding and producing oil and gas.
ConocoPhillips began publicly trading as an independent exploration and production company in 2012, building on a legacy that dates back 150 years to some of the earliest discoveries of oil and gas in the United States. That lineage includes energy pioneers such as Conoco, Phillips, Concho, Marathon Oil, Burlington Resources, DuPont, Marland Oil, Continental Oil and Standard Oil.
Our history illustrates a relentless focus on safety, a passion for innovation and an ability to adapt to a dynamic marketplace. We are proud of our commitment to improving life for people and communities.
Below are key moments in our history since 2012, when we became an independent exploration and production company.

pages.title: Our people | ConocoPhillips
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Our strategy, performance, culture and reputation are fueled by our workforce. We recognize that attracting, retaining and developing a world-class workforce is a competitive imperative within our complex industry.
Our Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Board of Directors help set our human capital management (HCM) strategy and drive accountability for meaningful progress. Our HCM programs are managed by our human resources function with support from business leaders across the company and are regularly reviewed by the Board of Directors.
We depend on our workforce to successfully execute our company’s strategy, and we recognize the importance of creating a workplace where our people feel valued. Our HCM approach is built around three pillars that we believe are necessary for success: a compelling culture, attracting a world-class workforce, and valuing our people.
U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) reports
We publicly disclose the ConocoPhillips Consolidated EEO-1 Report on a voluntary basis. The report characterizes our U.S. workforce by race, ethnicity and gender across job categories established by the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC). The makeup of our U.S. workforce is included below.
